rules.description: At least five payload-bearing OpenFlow transport segments; the actual drop-rule installation must be shown separately.
SYN attempt frames are present; identify the scanning endpoint and window separately.
Echo reply for the separate legitimate h3-to-h2 exchange. Adapt the addresses explicitly if E1 uses another topology.

manual_checks: Correlate the blocked h1 source with the installed flow and verify a complete h3-to-h2 ping during blocking.
Measure expiry under continuous matching traffic: hard_timeout implements the fixed API duration; idle_timeout measures inactivity.
R1 R2 R3: Correlate the alert, block request and actual installed drop flow. Capture before/after at the declared switch ports.
R4: Verify a full request/reply pair and measure hard_timeout expiry under continuous h1 traffic.
